payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Lawanna planning: I have strong fit on ui-ux-design tasks. My private costs: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage = 1.09 each; test = 1.52; implement = 2.17. ISSUE-0002 tasks are prohibitively expensive/infeasible for me (40/56/80). Tentative preference: claim one of ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage, with slight indifference among those three. Please share your best low-cost options so we avoid duplicates and maximize completed tasks.

Emil planning (iter 1): availability 9h. Strongest fit is data-science (0.84), then ui-ux-design (0.68). My private costs: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage=1.28 each; test=1.79; implement=2.56. ISSUE-0002 review=7.73; test=10.82; implement=15.45. Tentative recommendation for joint optimization: I can take one ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage cheaply, or ISSUE-0002::review is feasible but much costlier. Since maximizing tasks completed comes first, if others can cover remaining cheap ISSUE-0001 tasks, I may need to reserve ISSUE-0002::review as fallback to increase task count. Current soft preference: ISSUE-0002::review only if needed for coverage; otherwise one of ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage. Please share intended claims.

Raymond planning (iter 1): availability 9h. Strong fit on data-science (0.86) and documentation (0.81). My private costs: ISSUE-0002 review=4.29, test=6.01, implement=8.59; ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage=10.00 each, test=14.00, implement=20.00. I am clearly the best fit among my visible options for ISSUE-0002 tasks, especially ISSUE-0002::review or ::test. To maximize tasks completed and minimize total cost, my tentative preference is to reserve one ISSUE-0002 task rather than compete for cheap ISSUE-0001 subtasks. Soft preference: ISSUE-0002::review (lowest cost), with ISSUE-0002::test as backup if someone else has even lower cost on review. Please share if anyone is better positioned for ISSUE-0002 so we can avoid duplicates.

Lamont planning (iter 1): availability 4h. Strong fit on data-science (0.96) and documentation (0.82). My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review=4.04, ISSUE-0002::test=7.26, ISSUE-0002::implement=12.08; ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage=10.00 each, test=14.00, implement=20.00. Best feasible/low-cost option is clearly ISSUE-0002::review, with ISSUE-0002::test as backup. Since Raymond also reported ISSUE-0002::review at 4.29 and Emil at 7.73, I appear to be lowest-cost on ISSUE-0002::review. Tentative proposal: I reserve ISSUE-0002::review; Raymond can take ISSUE-0002::test or another data-science task if needed; Emil/Lawanna cover cheap ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage. Please avoid assigning me ISSUE-0001 tasks unless coverage forces it. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Frida planning (iter 1): availability 4h. Strong fit on ui-ux-design (0.94), then data-science (0.73). My private costs: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage=0.96 each; test=1.35; implement=1.93. ISSUE-0002 review=8.56; test=13.59; implement=21.13, so ISSUE-0002 is unattractive and some are likely infeasible/very costly. I am currently among the lowest-cost agents reported for ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (slightly lower than Lawanna 1.09 and Emil 1.28). Tentative preference: take one of ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage, with soft preference for ISSUE-0001::docs if unclaimed, then ::triage or ::review as backups. Given Lamont/Raymond are best on ISSUE-0002, joint plan suggestion: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test if he is willing, and Frida/Lawanna/Emil split ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage to maximize completed tasks and avoid duplicates. Please share/confirm intended ISSUE-0001 subtask choices so I can avoid overlap in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hipolito planning (iter 1): availability 5h. Strongest fit is documentation 0.78, then ui-ux-design 0.64. My private costs: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage = 1.36 each; test = 1.90; implement = 2.71. ISSUE-0002 review = 8.18, test = 12.05, implement = 19.36, so ISSUE-0002 is much less attractive. Given reported costs, I seem competitive for ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage but not the cheapest versus Frida/Lawanna/Emil. To maximize tasks completed, I can cover one remaining ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage slot if needed, or take ISSUE-0001::test at 1.90 if review/docs/triage are fully covered by lower-cost agents. Tentative preference ordering: ISSUE-0001::triage (if unclaimed) / ISSUE-0001::review / ISSUE-0001::docs, with ISSUE-0001::test as fallback if that improves coverage. Current suggested split: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, and among Frida/Lawanna/Emil/Hipolito we should cover distinct ISSUE-0001 subtasks, likely including ISSUE-0001::test so four of us do not collide on only three cheap admin subtasks. Please share intended exact ISSUE-0001 claims so I can avoid duplication in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Lawanna update (iter 1): based on reported costs, a high-coverage low-cost split seems to be Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review (4.04), Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test (6.01), and Frida/Emil/Lawanna/Hipolito covering four distinct ISSUE-0001 subtasks. Since Frida soft-prefers ISSUE-0001::docs and Hipolito mentioned triage/review with test fallback, I can help avoid collisions by tentatively reserving ISSUE-0001::review or ::triage. My own cheapest are review/docs/triage all equal at 1.09, test 1.52. To maximize tasks completed, I suggest exact provisional split: Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test. If anyone has conflicting stronger preference, please reply; otherwise I will likely execute ISSUE-0001::review.

Emil update (iter 1): I support the emerging 6-task coverage plan. Given costs reported, best exact split appears to be Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test, and Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage. My cost for ISSUE-0001::triage is 1.28, so I am happy to tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::triage to avoid collisions. If someone else urgently needs triage, my backups among ISSUE-0001 are review/docs at same cost 1.28, but current soft commitment is triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raymond update (iter 1): I support the emerging 6-task coverage plan and am happy to tentatively reserve ISSUE-0002::test for execution, with Lamont on ISSUE-0002::review. This seems to maximize completed tasks while keeping me off the expensive ISSUE-0001 work. I confirm my cost for ISSUE-0002::test is 6.01; ISSUE-0002::implement remains feasible at 8.59 but is a weaker fallback than keeping broad coverage. Current supported split from my side: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test. If anyone has a materially lower-cost alternative for ISSUE-0002::test or if collisions emerge on ISSUE-0001, please flag before execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Lamont update (iter 1): I support the emerging 6-task coverage plan and will tentatively reserve ISSUE-0002::review for execution. My cost there is 4.04, lower than reported alternatives, and ISSUE-0001 tasks are much worse for me. I confirm I will avoid ISSUE-0001 unless coverage unexpectedly changes. Supported provisional split from my side: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test. If anyone sees a better non-duplicate arrangement, please flag before execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Frida update (iter 1): I support the emerging 6-task coverage plan and can tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::docs for execution. My cost there is 0.96, tied with my lowest-cost options and aligned with my earlier soft preference. Unless new information appears, I will avoid ISSUE-0001::review/triage to prevent collisions and avoid ISSUE-0002 because my costs are much higher. Current supported split from my side: Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test, Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test. If anyone needs me to swap among ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage for deconfliction, I can, but docs is my tentative execution choice. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hipolito update (iter 1): I support the current 6-task coverage plan and can tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::test for execution. My cost there is 1.90, which is slightly higher than my review/docs/triage cost 1.36, but using ::test lets Frida/Lawanna/Emil cover the three cheaper distinct ISSUE-0001 admin subtasks while Lamont/Raymond cover ISSUE-0002 review/test. Unless new conflicting info appears, my planned execution choice is ISSUE-0001::test. Supported provisional split: Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test, Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test. If anyone cannot execute that assignment, please flag and I can swap to ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage as backup for deconfliction. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Lawanna planning confirmation (iter 1): I support the coordinated 6-task coverage plan and tentatively reserve ISSUE-0001::review for execution. My cost there is 1.09, and I will avoid ISSUE-0001::docs/triage and all ISSUE-0002 tasks unless the plan changes. Current supported split from my side: Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test, Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test. If any agent cannot execute their tentative claim, please notify before execution so I can swap among ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage as backup.

Emil planning confirmation (iter 1): I see broad convergence on the 6-task non-duplicate plan, which appears to maximize completed tasks at low cost: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage. I confirm my tentative execution choice remains ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.28). Backups only for deconfliction: ISSUE-0001::docs or ::review at same cost. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 unless this plan breaks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Raymond planning confirmation (iter 1): I confirm support for the coordinated 6-task non-duplicate plan, which appears to maximize completed tasks while keeping total cost low. My tentative execution choice remains ISSUE-0002::test (cost 6.01). I will avoid ISSUE-0002::review given Lamont’s lower cost there (4.04), and avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks unless the plan breaks. Supported split from my side: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test. If any agent cannot execute their tentative claim, please notify so I can consider fallback options such as ISSUE-0002::implement.

Lamont planning final (iter 1): no new conflicts seen. I continue to support the stable 6-task non-duplicate plan maximizing coverage at low cost: Lamont -> ISSUE-0002::review, Raymond -> ISSUE-0002::test, Frida -> ISSUE-0001::docs, Lawanna -> ISSUE-0001::review, Emil -> ISSUE-0001::triage, Hipolito -> ISSUE-0001::test. My tentative execution choice remains ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.04). If anything changes before execution, please flag immediately; otherwise I will avoid all ISSUE-0001 tasks and ISSUE-0002::test/implement.

Frida planning final (iter 1): no conflicts seen from my side. My tentative execution choice remains ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 0.96). If the plan changes unexpectedly, my deconfliction backups are ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review at same cost; otherwise I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and avoid colliding on other ISSUE-0001 subtasks.

Hipolito planning final (iter 1): no conflicts seen from my side. If the plan changes unexpectedly, my deconfliction backups are ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs; otherwise I will avoid ISSUE-0002 and avoid colliding on other ISSUE-0001 subtasks. (phase=planning, iter=1)

(phase=planning, iter=1)
